services.desc: All Trips are aboard our Coast Guard inspected vessel, Gusto. It is approved for carrying 12 Customers per trip. Any of our dolphin tours or sunset trip services that are reserved with a credit card are subject to be charged the full amount of the cost of the reserved item if not properly cancelled 24 hours prior to the reservation date and time. 24 HOUR CONCELLATION POLICY- Any of our reservation with a credit card are subject to be charged the full amount of the cost of the reserved item if not properly cancelled 24 hours prior to the reservation date and time. Come and parasail at Sarasota. Sarasota's newest and most experienced parasail company with over 10 years experience in FL. Site

blurb: Guests enjoy parasailing flights lasting 1.5 hours aboard the vessel Gusto, which is Coast Guard inspected and approved for 12 customers per trip. Reservations require a credit card and cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance to avoid full charge. The company emphasizes experienced staff and well-maintained equipment for a safe and enjoyable experience.
